newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank does not plan news conference.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank does not plan news conference.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it did not plan to hold a news conference after its regular fortnightly council meeting.
Economists did not expect the German central bank council to change official interest rates at the meeting.

Market attention instead focused on the council's expected plans to discuss Bonn's plan to revalue the Bundesbank's gold reserves in a bid to help solve Germany's debt problems in order to meet entry criteria for the single European currency.
The Bundesbank's statement that it would not hold a news conference contained no comment on whether the central bank would make a statement on the gold issue after the meeting.
The meeting was held a day earlier than usual due to a holiday in parts of Germany on Thursday.
